title: Exceptional!
text: We were fortunate to take the tour of Barcelona with Florence. She is an exceptional guide and very, very pedagogical. She was able to convey information not only about the architectural wonders but also to take us through history thanks to her deep knowledge and anecdotes that help remember the dates. Thank you for this beautiful moment in your company
author: nataliavR98LJ

title: Extraordinary walk
text:
Great discovery of Barcelona with Florence, she was able to engage both young and old with her knowledge, energy, and humor!
The binder with photos and maps adds a lot to the visit and makes you want to discover the buildings seen from the outside.
I highly recommend it!

title: In the footsteps of Gaudi
text: Superb visit appreciated by both young and old. Excellent explanations with a very friendly guide. I highly recommend it; you will not be disappointed.
